R9_unseparated: His data fitted by the project's model would need Bouvard's 1821 tables with his § 7 corrections at his 30 epochs (not transcribed). D2 cannot reach Neptune's distance: the 2:1 pole at α = 0.630 bounds the series, and the 3:1 pole at α = 0.481 found when the grid ran sits 0.02 inside Hypothesis I's α.
R10_prior_work: Brookes (1970) re-derived Hypothesis I from the memoir's equations (0.1509, 0.8267, 311° 35′, 323° 39′) and attributed the difference from Adams to an unnamed numerical error; C2 confirms his figures and locates the difference in the (n) normal equation of the second group. His Table X and conclusion give the α dependence at sin 29°–32°; D2's points sit beside them.
